ratings_why.fun: Every turn asks where the Phials go, whether to hold two, and which line to add, and the Warden, Drawn, Nurse and Pavonia stack in ways that reward slot planning; the heavy tracking keeps it from an 8.
ratings_why.distinct: 8 because no tribe today makes spells, and one shared Recipe that any tribe's unit can carry, which the Alchymist fills with other tribes' keywords, makes the Moths a bridge rather than a self-feeding engine.

verdict_why: The engine is settled; the Alchymist's copied keywords and the Mortar Grinder's 'hit by' still need rulings a player can read.

points.text: The Alchymist can copy Belly, Snap, Pack or Mire, but what each does as a Recipe line on a random target is still unwritten (the design's own risks say so). Add a short ruling per copied keyword, or a rule like 'a copied keyword works as on its own tribe'.

Mortar Grinder says 'hit by the most Phials': it is unclear whether a Warden splash, a Pavonia second cast or a Drawn gain counts as a hit. Say which, since it decides whether the lamp or its neighbours grow.
Psyche's death cast with Drawn units two slots away is a lovely hidden chain; a Drawn line on the Recipe makes her neighbours spread it further. Worth naming in the Lamp build so players find it.

The Herald's slot-order ruling (F1 fires every Burnet line, B3 none) is a great positioning puzzle; a card that cares about reading order the other way, say a back-row Herald-like cast at end of combat, could deepen it.
The once-a-turn scaling rule makes 'second Phial on a new target' the right call, which is a good decision; the Recipe card on screen should show which units have used their scaled gain this turn.

standouts.why: Stealing Mire, Bitter or Pack into a Recipe that pours on anything is pure outside-its-purpose play.
Burnt Ring Warden turns slot layout into the core puzzle: splash plus Drawn behind it plus Nurse plus Pavonia all multiply off one Phial.
Mother Shipton turns your own buff list into a curse, so line choices matter for attack and defence at once.

weakest.why: Wing-Dust Peddler is a plain Phial maker with no decision of its own.
Show-Globe Keeper does the same job as the Peddler, once a turn, with nothing to combo off.
Atropos is a discount and a restock; useful economy, but it only interacts through the Treacle Painter.

flags.note: Dame Pavonia doubles Nurse triggers, Grinder and Carbonaria counts and Drawn gains; with the Warden and a golden copy one Phial reaches many units several times.
Copied keywords like Belly with nothing inside, Snap without Mire, or Pack on a lone unit have no stated ruling.
Whether splash, double casts or Drawn gains count as 'hit by a Phial' is not stated.
